frontier_selector.why: Genetic testing at 12 months revealed F508del/3849 + 10kbC-T mutation, which is specific to Cystic Fibrosis.

support_spans: Initial sweat tests were uncertain (42-60 mmol/l)
Genetic testing at 12 months revealed F508del/3849 + 10kbC-T mutation
developed Pseudo-Bartter's syndrome (hypochloremia, hyponatremia, hypokalemia, and metabolic alkalosis)
regular oropharyngeal samples showed bacterial presence in amounts of 102-104 colony-forming units
Protein profile analysis showed homogeneity of isolates from 2015-2020
Computer tomography confirmed inflammatory alteration of the paranasal sinuses

contradict_spans: vitamin D level was within normal range
Blood chemistry had no significant deviations
